_about: Bots listed under deny are never recommended for unblocking. If one is allowed, the tools recommend blocking it. Edit this file to change the policy. Criteria: (1) operator based in a U.S. Commerce Dept. foreign-adversary country (15 CFR 791.4); (2) does not honor robots.txt by default or is publicly reported to evade blocks; (3) crawls to build or sell datasets rather than run an AI product.
